subject: Access artifacts & sample logs for SOC 2 / SIG — scope and timeline
messages:
From: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeops.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>; laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG intake — Access control artifacts request

Hi Ben / Laura,

We're working through AcmeOps' onboarding SOC 2 review and the security team had a few follow-ups after the initial questionnaire. Can you help with a short checklist and sample artifacts for the following items? We need enough detail to validate control implementation — samples are fine, production redaction acceptable.

1) SSO / SAML: one successful assertion sample for a federated login (timestamped, with NameID and attributes) and a description of IdP metadata / signing cert rotation cadence.
2) SCIM: example of a SCIM delta export showing user create/update/delete for a 7-day window and the inbound mapping used for group membership.
3) RBAC / least-privilege: an owner-mapped role listing for service accounts + a short narrative on your role review cadence and exception handling process.
4) Audit logs: an extract of authorization decision logs (redacted) for a sample user over 3 days showing session start/end and admin elevation events.

Target timeline: can you confirm what you can provide by COB Monday PST? Also call out anything that needs an NDA/procurement signoff before we share.

Thanks,
Jane Park
Senior InfoSec Analyst
AcmeOps

--
AcmeOps security@acmeops.com
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeops.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG intake — Access control artifacts request

Jane —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide samples for each item; a couple notes up front so expectations are aligned:

- SSO/SAML: we can share an assertion sample and the IdP metadata. We rotate signing certs annually and keep rotation records in the key-management playbook — I'll attach the assertion sample.
- SCIM: we can export a 7-day delta (CSV) that includes before/after values. We will redact PII (emails) in the sample if preferred.
- RBAC: we'll provide an owner-mapped workbook for service accounts and a short process doc for periodic reviews.
- Audit logs: we can include a 3-day excerpt of authorization events. For full log exports we typically require a data-sharing addendum; the redacted sample should be fine for initial review.

COB Monday PST is doable for the samples (we'll provide redacted artifacts). If AcmeOps needs logs with full identifiers we can route that through legal/procurement.

I'll loop in Marcus (platform security) and Rachel (compliance ops) to assemble.

Next steps: Marcus — can you confirm the SAML assertion sample and SCIM delta snapshot we should drop into the package? Rachel — can you prepare the role-owner mapping and a short review cadence blurb?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sso-assertion-sample.xml (attached)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jane Park <jane.park@acmeops.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 10:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG intake — Access control artifacts request

Ben / Jane —

Quick technical clarifications from our side to make sure the samples meet AcmeOps' review:

- For SAML, do you need a real IdP-initiated flow assertion or is an SP-initiated assertion example acceptable? We generally provide SP-initiated.
- For SCIM, confirm whether you need the full resource representation or only the delta rows (create/replace/patch/delete). We can supply both but the delta CSV is smaller.
- RBAC workbook: we'll include separate tabs for (1) service accounts, (2) human role owners, and (3) temporary elevation approvals for the last 90 days.
- Logs: our authorization decision log format is JSONL; we'll convert a small sample to CSV for easier review and redact user identifiers unless you have an approved DSA.

@Jane — if you can confirm SP vs IdP assertion and delta-only vs full SCIM payloads, we'll lock the package and aim to send first drop by Monday 18:00 PST.

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Mar 27, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT Jane Park <jane.park@acmeops.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben / Laura,
> 
> We're working through AcmeOps' onboarding SOC 2 review and the security team had a few follow-ups after the initial questionnaire...

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeops.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmeops.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG intake — Access control artifacts request

Jane —

Thanks for confirming. Final package details below and attached artifacts (redacted samples):

1) SSO / SAML
- Included: redwood-sso-assertion-sample.xml (SP-initiated sample), README.md with IdP metadata URL and cert rotation cadence (rotation: annual; emergency rotation policy included).

2) SCIM
- Included: scim-delta-snapshot.csv (7-day delta with create/update/delete rows). We redacted user emails and replaced with internal IDs per our standard data-sharing policy. If you need full email values we will escalate for an NDA/DSA.

3) RBAC / least-privilege
- Included: rbac-owner-mapping.xlsx (tabs for service accounts, human owners, temporary elevs). Attached is a 1-page process note: role_review_ cadence.txt describing quarterly reviews and exception approval flow.

4) Audit logs
- Included: authz-events-sample.csv (3-day snippet converted from JSONL and redacted). For broader access to raw JSONL logs please route through procurement/legal.

Timeline: We have delivered the redacted samples now. If AcmeOps wants additional unredacted artifacts we'll work with procurement for a DSA and provide a secure transfer.

Action items: Jane/procurement — confirm whether the redacted samples suffice for your SOC 2 desk review or if you require exec-level signoff and a DSA for more detailed data.

Ben
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sso-assertion-sample.xml; scim-delta-snapshot.csv; rbac-owner-mapping.xlsx; authz-events-sample.csv
